children: Australia’s seasonally adjusted unemployment rate inched up to 4.6% in August, surpassing both market expectations and July’s figure of 4.5%.

It was the highest since November 2021, as the number of unemployed increased by 28,200 to 722,900 from 694,700 in July, with the number of part-time employees increasing by 12,500 to 242,000, while the number of full-time employees climbed by 15,700 to 481,000.
Meanwhile, employment rose by 39,500 to 14.84 million, above expectations for a 20,000 increase, after an upwardly revised loss of 15,900 jobs in July.
Part-time employment advanced by 45,800 to 4.64 million, while full-time employment decreased by 6,300 to 10.19 million.

title: Australia Jobless Rate at Near 5-Year High
